scope: Source-supported acquisition contract only; actual native widget ObjectOpen/permissions/behavior not executed.
checks: Existing handling factory checks exact original document identity/mode, external-source opening and original edit permission. It contains no editor-layout or mounted-view requirement.
PreparedEditorPageDocument.validate checks nonempty exact object/Space/mode/opened state; no page-details or layout requirement.

PreparedEditorPageSession constructs original delegates and same owner without claiming assembly or attaching a controller; direct child acquisition is already supported by PreparedEditorChildPreparation.performMutation.
Owner read/mutation admission checks exact instance/object/Space/mode/source/account/session lifetimes and original document permissions. Assembly/host claims are separate later methods.
Original ObjectPermissions.canEditBlocks uses lock/version/archive/participant/restrictions, not resolvedLayout. Actual widget restrictions can still reject; no flags are relaxed.
Existing-open cached documents remain rejected by bbd external acquisition; no fallback or adoption path introduced.
conditional_result: A fresh original widget document satisfying unchanged existing identity and permission gates can be acquired without a view mount; actual per-target restrictions are authoritative and may reject.
